body: Yeah, everything in the `.targets` file should probably be conditional. This was overlooked when I moved some things from `.props` to `.targets`.
I disagree with this fix. full pdb's only work for Windows. xunit needs to work cross platform. the code coverage tools must be fixed to support portable and embedded pdb's.

@onovotny You are right, Code coverage should work with portable PDB. Tracking here https://github.com/Microsoft/vstest/issues/800 . This is not coming in 15.5. 

But having condition helps for scenarios which depends on PDB type.
In the end, I decided to only set `DebugType` conditionally, because the other things are absolutely required (for example, binding redirects generation in desktop CLR).

Also, last time I tried, the current profiling stuff in VS2017 didn't support .NET Core. It's running unconditionally with TPv1 which doesn't support it. So unless this was fixed in 15.4, this change isn't going to make you any happier.
It should work with above template mentioned in `Steps to reproduce` with VS 15.3 and with this fix.

body:
I am using .netcore 2.4 with xUnit and I was able to fix the issue by adding `<DebugType>Full</DebugType>`

```
  <PropertyGroup>
    <DebugType>Full</DebugType>
  </PropertyGroup>
```
